From 0ce73a0eb5a27070957b67fd74059b6da89cc516 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 12:52:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] can: ems_usb: ems_usb_read_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory
 leak

Fix similar memory leak as in commit 7352e1d5932a ("can: gs_usb:
gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory leak").

In ems_usb_open(), the URBs for USB-in transfers are allocated, added to
the dev->rx_submitted anchor and submitted. In the complete callback
ems_usb_read_bulk_callback(), the URBs are processed and resubmitted. In
ems_usb_close() the URBs are freed by calling
usb_kill_anchored_urbs(&dev->rx_submitted).

However, this does not take into account that the USB framework unanchors
the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an
in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not
released in ems_usb_close().

Fix the memory leak by anchoring the URB in the
ems_usb_read_bulk_callback() to the dev->rx_submitted anchor.

Fixes: 702171adeed3 ("ems_usb: Added support for EMS CPC-USB/ARM7 CAN/USB interface")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260116-can_usb-fix-memory-leak-v2-1-4b8cb2915571@pengutronix.de
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/usb/ems_usb.c b/drivers/net/can/usb/ems_usb.c
index de8e212a1366..4c219a5b139b 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/usb/ems_usb.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/usb/ems_usb.c
@@ -486,11 +486,17 @@ static void ems_usb_read_bulk_callback(struct urb *urb)
 			  urb->transfer_buffer, RX_BUFFER_SIZE,
 			  ems_usb_read_bulk_callback, dev);
 
+	usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted);
+
 	retval = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);
+	if (!retval)
+		return;
+
+	usb_unanchor_urb(urb);
 
 	if (retval == -ENODEV)
 		netif_device_detach(netdev);
-	else if (retval)
+	else
 		netdev_err(netdev,
 			   "failed resubmitting read bulk urb: %d\n", retval);
 }
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a URB memory leak in the ems_usb CAN driver by adjusting the URB lifecycle in the `ems_usb_read_bulk_callback()` function.

**Modifications in `drivers/net/can/usb/ems_usb.c`**:
- Added `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)` after reinitializing the URB with `usb_fill_bulk_urb()` and before calling `usb_submit_urb()`.
- Changed the error handling: after `usb_submit_urb()`, if the submission succeeds (`retval == 0`), the function returns immediately (the URB remains anchored). If it fails, the URB is unanchored with `usb_unanchor_urb(urb)`.
- Simplified the error handling: the previous conditional branch for `retval == -ENODEV` (detaching the net device) is kept, but the `else if (retval)` is changed to just `else`, so that any submission failure prints the error message (previously only non-ENODEV errors were printed).

**Relationship between modifications**:
The core issue was that the USB framework unanchors the URB before the completion callback is invoked. Therefore, the URB was no longer part of the `dev->rx_submitted` anchor list when `ems_usb_close()` called `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()`, causing the URB to never be freed. By anchoring the URB again in the callback, the URB remains in the anchor list after processing. On successful resubmission, the URB stays anchored; on failure, it is unanchored to prevent a dangling reference. This ensures all URBs are properly freed when the device is closed, resolving the memory leak.
